name: print-social-green-event-countdown-poster-series
title: Green Event Countdown Poster Series
whatItIs: A deep green board with white event posters: '03 days left' with a giant numeral and red and green ribbon, 'ONE day to go', and cropped QR and phone posters, with a vertical 'Countdown' label.
whatItMeans: Big numerals make the countdown instantly readable, and the shared header pattern ties the series together.
techniques: Giant numerals as the focal graphic
Coloured header strip of shapes on every poster
Details row with date, place and time chips

vocabulary.definition: An oversized number showing days remaining.
A repeated band of shapes along the top of posters.
Small labels for date, place and time.
